name: Tabs
description: Accessible tabs with a sliding indicator (underline, pill or segmented), horizontal or vertical, automatic or manual activation, and crossfading panels.
useWhen: Related content must be split into panels on one page, such as Overview, Specs and Reviews
A settings or profile view groups sections behind a horizontal or vertical tab list

avoidWhen.when: Users need to read several sections at once, or many sections must fit a narrow screen
The control switches a value or mode rather than showing a content panel
The sections form an ordered process with completed and upcoming steps

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value of the active tab (the tab’s data-value, otherwise its index). Reflected on every change.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: automatic: arrows activate the tab; manual: arrows move focus, Enter/Space activates.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: List above or to the left of the panels; also changes the arrow keys.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: segmented: gray track with a raised pill; pill: accent pill with no track; underline: sliding accent bar.

methods.name: select(value)
methods.description: Activates the tab with that value and emits mv-change.

events.name: mv-change
events.description: User-initiated change. detail: { value, previous, tab, panel }.

slots.name: [role=tablist]
slots.description: The first tablist under the host; contains the <button role="tab"> elements (optional data-value, can be disabled). Wrappers are allowed in between, such as <li role="presentation"> items in a <ul role="tablist">.

slots.name: [role=tabpanel]
slots.description: Panels anywhere under <mv-tabs>, wrappers allowed, matched by data-value or by order. A tablist or panel inside a panel, or inside a nested <mv-tabs>, belongs to that one.

classes.name: mv-tabs-indicator
classes.description: Sliding indicator, created automatically inside the list.

classes.name: mv-tabs-count
classes.description: Count badge inside a tab (gets accented when the tab is active).

cssVars.name: --mv-tabs-x / -y / -w / -h
cssVars.description: Indicator position and size, written by the JS (read-only).

a11y: ARIA Tabs pattern: tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, aria-selected, aria-controls and aria-labelledby wired automatically, aria-orientation. Roving tabindex: a single Tab stop to enter the list, arrows (left/right or up/down depending on orientation), Home/End; disabled tabs are skipped. Panels get tabindex=0 and inactive panels are hidden. Reduced motion: instant indicator and fade. Wrapper elements may sit between the host, the tablist, the tabs and the panels (a framework component that renders its own root); a nested mv-tabs, and anything inside a panel, keeps its own tabs. Known limits: panels inside a wrapper are not stacked in one grid cell, so the outgoing panel leaves at once instead of crossfading. Styling wrapped markup relies on CSS @scope (all current engines); without it, only the direct markup (tablist and panels as children of mv-tabs, tabs as children of the tablist) is styled, while wrapped tabs keep working unstyled.
